plan.paradox: A razor sells itself. And blades never stop coming.
plan.odd_fact: 1904: ninety-thousand razors, one-hundred-twenty-three thousand blades. Looks generous.
plan.twist: It locks you into buying blades forever.

beats.say: A razor sells itself. And blades never stop coming.
Buy razor with a few starter blades.
Buy razor plus a subscription of endless blades.
1904: ninety-thousand razors, one-hundred-twenty-three thousand blades. Looks generous.
But it does a job - locking you into blade purchases.
The subscription bundle turns every buyer into a repeat customer.
123,648 blades sold in year two prove the repeat demand.
The handle is cheap; the profit hides in blade sales.
